title: RBI Penalty Orders on NBFCs for Regulatory Non-Compliance
description: <cite index="18-1,18-6">RBI imposed a penalty of ₹6.20 lakh on Avail Financial Services Limited through an order dated July 10, 2026, for violations of governance and credit/investment concentration norms.</cite> <cite index="18-10">Muthoot Finance Limited was fined ₹5.80 lakh through an order dated July 10, 2026, for violating RBI's KYC Directions.</cite>
